Corporate   Automated Systems Holdings Limited (“ASL” or the “Group”) was listed on The
            Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited in 1997 (Stock Code: 771). Leveraging its
Profile     unified technology services capabilities – including application development (Dev),
            cybersecurity (Sec) and omni-channel managed services (Ops) – the Group applies
            advanced technologies to facilitate clients’ digital transformation, with a focus on
            sectors such as government, healthcare, banking, finance, securities, insurance,
            education, and aviation.


            The Group’s primary business operations are located in Hong Kong and Macau,
            with a presence extending to the Asia Pacific, Europe and the U.S. Backed by
            numerous offshore development centers and service centers in Asia Pacific and
            over a thousand high-caliber experts, ASL is a professional and trustworthy unified
            technology services partner.




企業簡介        自動系統集團有限公司（「ASL集團」或「集團」）於1997年在香港聯合交易所有限公司
            上市
             （股份代號：771）
                      。憑藉涵蓋應用程序開發 (Dev)、網絡安全 (Sec) 及全渠道管理
            (Ops) 的融合科技服務能力，運用領先技術助力政府、醫療、銀行、金融、證券、保
            險、教育及航空等重點行業客戶實現數碼轉型。


            集團的主要業務以港澳為核心，業務範圍覆蓋亞太及歐美地區，並於亞太地區擁有
            多個離岸開發中心及服務中心，過千位高質素的專業人才，是專業可靠的融合科技
            服務夥伴。

Adjusted EBITDA: Adjusted Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation,          經調整EBITDA：經調整除息稅、折舊及攤銷前利潤
and Amortisation (“Adjusted EBITDA”) is calculated based on profit for the year   金額（「經調整EBITDA」）乃基於年內溢利扣除利息收
excluding interest income and expenses, tax, depreciation and amortisation,       入及開支、稅項、折舊及攤銷、以股份為基礎支付
equity-settled share-based payments expense, share of results of associates,      的開支、應佔聯營公司業績、投資物業之公允價值
fair value loss onin vestment properties, dividend income from financial asset    變動、按公允價值計入其他全面收益之金融資產的
at FVOCI, gain on disposal of interest in an associate, net gain/loss on deemed   股息收入、除稅後之出售聯營公司出售聯營公司權
disposal of partial interest in an associate and one-off professional fee.        益之收益、視作出售一間聯營公司部分權益之淨收
                                                                                  益及一次性專業費用。


Adjusted Net Profit: Adjusted Net Profit is calculated based on Adjusted          經調整溢利： 經調整溢利之金額乃基於經調整
EBITDA adding back interest income and expenses, depreciation and                 EBITDA加回折舊及攤銷、所得稅費用及以股份為基
amortisation, income tax expense and tax adjustments from the equity-             礎支付的開支及出售聯營公司部分權益之稅務調整。
settled share-based payments expense and gain on disposal of interest in an
associate.


Adjusted Operating Cash Flow: Operating cash flow of core business is             經調整經營現金流量：核心業務之經營現金流量乃
calculated based on net cash from operating activities of the Group excluding     基於本集團經營業務現金之現金收入淨額扣除一次

              Sustainable Teamwork and Community Engagement
                                           協同共進·社群永續

In 2025, The Group continued to advance its commitment to sustainability,            二零二五年，本集團堅守可持續發展承諾，積極推進
prioritizing the creation of enduring value for shareholders, customers,             各項相關舉措，以為股東、客戶、員工及社會創造長
employees, and the broader community. Our strategic integration of                   期價值為發展核心。我們將可持續發展經營理念策略
sustainable practices throughout our operations has further reinforced               性融入各項營運層面，進一步鞏固各持份者對本集團
stakeholder trust and support, positioning us for sustained growth and long-         的信任與支持，為本集團的持續增長與長遠發展韌性
term resilience.                                                                     奠定堅實基礎。




ASL strengthened our social commitment through youth development, community partnerships, and comprehensive employee
wellness programs. We nurtured emerging talent by hosting an office visit to inspire young people toward innovation and technology
careers and sponsored the GBA STEAM Excellence Award 2025 to encourage the next generation in pursuing STEAM fields. Our
community engagement included sourcing Mid-Autumn Festival mooncakes from the ORBIS Charity Sale to support sight-saving
initiatives and participating in the Shatin Dragon Boat Race 2025 to build team spirit. We enhanced employee well-being through
targeted workshops on workplace ergonomics and mental wellness, creating a healthier and more positive workplace culture.

ASL透過培育青年發展、建立社區夥伴協作及推行全面的員工關懷計劃，加強社會責任承諾。我們透過舉辦辦公室參觀活動培育新興人
才，啟發年輕人投身創新科技行業，並贊助2025年大灣區STEAM卓越獎，鼓勵新一代投身科學、科技、工程、藝術及數學領域 (STEAM)
的發展。我們的社區參與包括從奧比斯慈善義賣選購中秋節月餅，以支持護眼項目，亦參與2025年沙田龍舟競賽，建立團隊精神。我們亦
透過工作間人體工學及心理健康等主題工作坊，加強員工身心健康，締造更健康正面的辦公室文化。

      Corporate assets are allocated to individual cash-generating units,                試。企業資產在可識別合理且一致的分配

               Measurement of ECLs                                                          預期信貸款損的計量

               estimate of credit losses over the expected life of the financial            年限內信貸虧損之概率加權估計釐定。
               instrument.

               undue cost or effort. This includes both quantitative and qualitative        可支持的資訊。這包括基於本集團的過往
               information and analysis, based on the Group’s historical experience         經驗與知情信用評估的定量與定性的資訊

               information.


               ECLs are measured on either of the following bases:                          預期信貸虧損採用以下基準計量：

               •   12-month ECLs: these are losses that are expected to result from         •   十二個月預期信貸虧損：預期在期未
                   possible default events within the 12 months after the reporting             日後十二個月內可能發生之違約事件
                   date; and                                                                    而導致之虧損；及

               •   lifetime ECLs: these are losses that are expected to result from         •   全期預期信貸虧損：預期採用預期信
                   all possible default events over the expected lives of the items to          貸虧損模式之項目在預計年限內所有
                   which the ECL model applies.                                                 可能發生之違約事件而導致之虧損。

               allowance equal to 12-month ECLs unless there has been a significant         虧損撥備相等於十二個月預期信貸虧損，
               increase in credit risk of the financial instrument since initial            除非自初始確認起金融工具之信貸風險顯
               recognition, in which case the loss allowance is measured at an              著增加，於此情況下，虧損撥備按相等於
               amount equal to lifetime ECLs.                                               全期預期信貸虧損之金額計量。

            Definition of lease                                                                   租賃之定義

            At inception of a contract, the Group considers whether a                             在簽訂合同時，本集團會考慮合約是
            contract is, or contains a lease. A lease is defined as ‘a contract,                  否屬於或包含租賃。租賃已定義為「以
            or part of a contract, that conveys the right to use an identified                    代價換取已識別資產（相關資產）於一
            asset (the underlying asset) for a period of time in exchange for                     段時間之使用權之一項合約或合約之
            consideration’.                                                                       一部分」。

            To apply this definition, the Group assesses whether the contract                     為應用此定義，本集團評估有關合約
            meets three key evaluations which are whether:                                        是否符合以下三個主要評估：

            •    the contract contains an identified asset, which is either                       •   有關合約是否包含一項已識別資
                 explicitly identified in the contract or implicitly specified by                     產，無論有關資產於合約中明示
                 being identified at the time the asset is made available to the                      或透過資產在可供本集團使用時
                 Group;                                                                               獲識別之方式作出暗示；

            •    the Group has the right to obtain substantially all of                           •   考慮到就有關合約所訂明範圍內
                 the economic benefits from use of the identified asset                               之權利，本集團是否有權獲得於
                 throughout the period of use, considering its rights within                          整個使用期間內使用已識別資產
                 the defined scope of the contract; and                                               所產生之絕大部分經濟利益；及

            •    the Group has the right to direct the use of the identified                      •   本集團是否有權於使用期間內指
                 asset throughout the period of use. The Group assess                                 示已識別資產之用途。本集團評
                 whether it has the right to direct ‘how and for what purpose’                        估其是否有權於使用期間內指示
                 the asset is used throughout the period of use.                                      資產之「使用方式及用途」。

 on recommendations of the management of the Group, the Group will                               息、發行新股份、銀行借貸及購回股份及在有
